NONE: › an act of staying awake, especially at night, in order to be with a person who is very ill or dying, or to make a protest, or to pray
（陪伴病人、祈禱、表達不同政見等的）不眠時間；（尤指）值夜，守夜

example: His parents kept vigil beside his bed for weeks before he died.
他去世之前，父母在他床邊守夜守了好幾個星期。
Supporters of the peace movement held an all-night candlelit vigil outside the cathedral.
和平運動的支持者們在大教堂外舉行了一次持續一整夜的燭光守夜祈禱活動。

NONE: › more careful attention, especially in order to notice possible danger

example: The police said that it was thanks to the vigilance of a neighbour that the fire was discovered before it could spread.
警方說多虧了一位鄰居警覺才在火災蔓延之前發現了火情。

NONE: › always being careful to notice things, especially possible danger

example: Following the bomb scare at the airport, the staff have been warned to be extra vigilant.
機場的炸彈恐嚇事件之後，全體員工都被告誡要格外警惕。

NONE: › a person who tries in an unofficial way to prevent crime, or to catch and punish someone who has committed a crime, especially because they do not think that official organizations, such as the police, are controlling crime effectively. Vigilantes usually join together to form groups.
（尤指認為警方無法維持治安而自發組織起來的）治安會會員，治安維持者
› a short piece of writing, music, acting, etc. that clearly expresses the typical characteristics of something or someone
（清晰描述特點的）短文，片段，小插曲

example: She wrote several vignettes of small-town life.
她寫了幾篇關於小鎮生活的短文。

NONE: 充滿活力的；有力量的；精力旺盛的

example: a vigorous debate
激烈的辯論
There has been vigorous opposition to the proposals for a new road.
修建一條新路的提議遭到了強烈的反對。
He takes plenty of vigorous exercise.
他做大量的劇烈運動。
Cutting the bush back in the autumn will help promote vigorous growth in the spring.
秋天將灌木叢剪短有利於它在春天茁壯生長。

NONE: › strength of thought, opinion, expression, etc.

example: They set about their work with youthful vigour and enthusiasm.
他們帶著年輕人的活力與熱情開始了工作。
He gave his side of the story with vigour.
他充滿激情地從自己的角度講述了這件事。
